howToRequest.title: How to Request Data Deletion
howToRequest.intro: If you would like us to delete your personal data from Nestor App CRM, please follow these steps:
howToRequest.step1: Send an email to georgios.pagonis@gmail.com with the subject line "Data Deletion Request"
howToRequest.step2: Include the platform you used to contact us (Facebook Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp, or Telegram) and your username or phone number
howToRequest.step3: We will process your request within 30 days and confirm deletion via email

whatWeDelete.title: What We Delete
whatWeDelete.item2: Your contact information and platform identifiers

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: For questions about data deletion, contact us at: georgios.pagonis@gmail.com

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Nestor App CRM ("we", "our", "us") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you interact with our application and services, including integrations with Facebook Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Telegram.

dataWeCollect.title: 2. Data We Collect
dataWeCollect.item1: Messages you send to us through social media platforms (text content only)
dataWeCollect.item2: Your platform user ID (e.g., Facebook PSID, Instagram IGSID, phone number)

howWeUse.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
howWeUse.item1: To respond to your inquiries and provide customer support
howWeUse.item2: To manage business communications via our CRM system
howWeUse.item3: To improve our services and response quality

dataSharing.title: 4. Data Sharing
dataSharing.content: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties, except as required by law or to provide the services you requested (e.g., AI-powered responses via OpenAI).

dataRetention.title: 5. Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain your messages and contact information for as long as necessary to provide our services. You may request deletion of your data at any time.

registryData.title: 6. Business Data from the General Commercial Registry (GEMI)
registryData.intro: When an organisation's administrator clicks "Verify with GEMI", we query the Greek General Commercial Registry (GEMI) for the GEMI number stated in the organisation's profile and keep a copy of the answer. Data about legal persons is not personal data; for a sole proprietorship, however, it relates to a natural person, which is why the following applies.
registryData.source: Source: the GEMI open data service (businessportal.gr), a public registry, licensed under the Open Data Commons Attribution License (ODC-BY 1.0). We do not collect this data from you.
registryData.categories: What we keep: GEMI number · legal name and distinctive titles (including in Latin characters) · legal form · status in the registry · registered office (street, number, postal code, city, municipality) · whether it is a branch · whether the registry itself marks the data as incomplete · the date of the check. We do not keep names of partners or managers, capital, shares or tax ID (AFM).
registryData.purpose: Purpose: to check that the number and legal name in the profile match the registry and show the administrator any difference, with the option to adopt the registry's legal name; to let the agency's public page show the verification together with the date of the check; and, when the registry states the business is inactive, to have its page say so and not offer contact details or a new mandate.
registryData.legalBasis: Legal basis: the contract with the organisation using the platform (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR), for the check it requests itself; and legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR), so that people approaching a business through the platform are protected from dealing with a business the public registry states is inactive. We do not rely on consent.
registryData.publication: What becomes public: only what the organisation chooses when it publishes its page — legal name, legal form, GEMI number and registered office to the extent it selects (full address, shop address or municipality only) — together with the verification notice and the date of the check, or the notice that the registry states the business is inactive.
registryData.retention: Retention: we keep the copy only while it concerns the GEMI number currently stated in the organisation's profile. It is deleted when the number in the profile is changed or removed (together with saving the profile), when GEMI answers that the number does not exist, or when the administrator clicks "Delete the GEMI data we hold" on the "Business registry (GEMI)" page. A registry answer for a number the profile no longer states is not stored. Every deletion is recorded in the audit log with the reason, the GEMI number, the date of the deleted check and the user who caused it — without legal name or address.
registryData.objection: Erasure and objection (Articles 17 and 21 GDPR): the organisation's administrator can delete the copy at any time with the button above; after deletion we do not query GEMI again unless "Verify with GEMI" is clicked again. If the data relates to you but you are not the administrator, email us at the address in the "Contact" section.
registryData.complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (www.dpa.gr).

yourRights.title: 7. Your Rights
yourRights.content: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. Contact us at georgios.pagonis@gmail.com to exercise your rights.
